title: Finish Deposit Percent After Returned Payments on Design Studio Selections Files
content:
Where option deposit payments have come back unpaid, the finish deposit percent on a Design Studio Selections file is set by the option deposit payments returned unpaid on the file in the last 12 months:

| Option deposit payments returned unpaid in the last 12 months | Finish deposit percent |
|---|---|
| Two or more | The package's elevated ladder percent |
| Exactly one | 35 percent |
| None | The package's finish deposit percent |

**By package**

| Package | Two or more returned (elevated ladder percent) | Exactly one returned | None returned (package finish deposit percent) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Studio Essentials | 50 | 35 | 25 |
| Studio Classic | 50 | 35 | 25 |
| Studio Select | 50 | 35 | 25 |
| Studio Designer | 50 | 35 | 25 |
| Studio Signature | 50 | 35 | 25 |
| Studio Atelier | 50 | 35 | 20 |

**Records read.** The returned-payment entries on the file's design ledger dated within the last 12 months.

*Hypothetical case:* a Studio Atelier file with one returned payment eight months ago and another fourteen months ago counts one return in the last 12 months: 35 percent.
